title: Has AI Made You A Lazier Developer? Be Honest.
why_read: A reflective opinion piece on AI-assisted coding and productivity, thoughtful in tone but light on new technical content.
analysis: This essay explores whether AI coding assistants make developers lazy in a harmful way versus a productive way, invoking Larry Wall's classic notion of laziness as a programming virtue. It's a personal, discursive take rather than an empirical study or technical deep dive, aimed at prompting reflection rather than delivering actionable insight. Readers looking for data or concrete engineering guidance will find little here beyond anecdote and philosophy.
